user.title: CurEnergía mailbox
user.description: Enter the IMAP account that receives your CurEnergía invoices. Use an app password, not your normal password. An app password gives access to the whole mailbox, so create it only for this purpose and revoke it if you stop using the integration. See the [README](https://github.com/yuuues/hacs-curenergia#readme) for the steps.

data_description.host: Address of the IMAP server, for example imap.gmail.com.
data_description.port: SSL port of the IMAP server. Usually 993.

folder.title: Invoices folder
folder.description: Choose the folder where the CurEnergía e-mails are. Only e-mails from the CurEnergía sender are read.

data_description.folder: Mailbox folder to search for invoices.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CurEnergía
reauth_confirm.description: The mailbox rejected the saved password. Enter a new app password.

data_description.password: New app password of the mailbox.

error.invalid_auth: The mailbox rejected the username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the mailbox.

init.title: CurEnergía options
init.description: Changing the folder discards the stored mailbox state, so the new folder is read from scratch.

data_description.folder: Mailbox folder to search for invoices.
data_description.scan_hours: How often the mailbox is checked, from 1 to 24 hours.
data_description.kwh_threshold: An invoice is flagged when its consumption differs from e-data by more than this many kWh.
data_description.eur_threshold_pct: An invoice is flagged when its amount differs from e-data by more than this percentage.
data_description.show_panel: Show the CurEnergía panel in the sidebar.
data_description.save_pdfs: Keep a copy of each invoice PDF.
data_description.edata_entry: e-data entry to compare against. Automatic links it by supply point (CUPS).

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the folders from the mailbox. Type the folder name instead.
